| `id` | `string \| undefined` | no | `undefined` | Unique element ID (prefer `useId()` from Vue 3.5 when auto-generated) |
| `items` | `DzAnchorItem[]` | yes | — | Anchor entries to render (nested via `children`). |
| `offsetTop` | `number \| undefined` | no | `0` | Pixel offset from the top of the viewport used for both scrollspy detection and the scroll landing position (mirrors a sticky header height). |

## Usage (from `packages/core/stories/navigation/DzAnchor.stories.ts`, story `Default`)

```vue

      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-8">
        <DzAnchor :items="items" class="w-48 max-w-full shrink-0" />
        <div class="flex-1 space-y-8" v-html="article" />
      </div>
    
```
